name: dumbbell high low carry
description: A walking carry with one dumbbell overhead and one at your side. The mismatch trains shoulder stability and trunk control.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with a locked, stable arm and the other at your side.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps and keep the top arm stacked over your shoulder.
Walk the set distance, then lower the weights carefully.
